cloudflare_turnstile.explanation: A Cloudflare Turnstile challenge was encountered. Automated agents are strictly restricted from attempting to bypass or evade bot verification per Krama safety baseline rules.

cloudflare_challenge.explanation: A Cloudflare security challenge or bot interstitial was detected. Automated bypass is strictly prevented per safety policy.

recaptcha.explanation: A Google reCAPTCHA challenge was detected on the page. Automated solving is disallowed; manual resolution is required.

hcaptcha.explanation: An hCaptcha challenge was detected on the page. Automated solving is disallowed; manual resolution is required.

captcha.explanation: A bot detection challenge (CAPTCHA) was encountered. Human intervention is required to complete the verification before automation can continue.

auth_wall.explanation: A login screen or authentication gate was reached that requires user authentication credentials. Manual sign-in is required before automation can proceed.

login_wall.explanation: A login screen or authentication gate was reached that requires user authentication credentials. Manual sign-in is required before automation can proceed.

restricted.unknownExplanation: An anti-bot challenge or authentication restriction was encountered. Automated bypass is prohibited per safety baseline rules.
restricted.title: Automation restricted
restricted.how1: Click “Open Target URL” to view the blocked challenge page in your browser.
restricted.how2: Complete the CAPTCHA puzzle, check Turnstile verification, or sign into your account manually.
restricted.how3: Finish the remaining steps yourself. The automated run has stopped and cannot be resumed; start a new task once the site no longer shows the challenge.

rationale.destructive_action: This action is flagged as destructive and may permanently modify or remove resources. Human approval is required to proceed.
rationale.sensitive_data: This step involves sensitive data exposure or credentials entry and requires explicit confirmation.
rationale.prompt_injection: Potential adversarial instructions were detected in the web page DOM. Automated execution is held for human confirmation.
rationale.default: A safety policy rule requires manual verification before this step can execute.

policyModal.title: Policy Confirmation Required
policyModal.description: Execution paused at <step>Step {seq}</step> awaiting explicit human authorization.
